source: Kickoff Workflow Mapping Sprint, Board 4 (Ops, PO amendments), 12 Sep 2026, plus the program's Week 1 lesson that lead time and payment terms belong to the Category Manager. The 2K threshold and its currency are not confirmed yet. Gap cases (under 5 percent but 2K or more, and exactly 5 percent) go to the Category Manager as the safer default, decided by Lawrence on 25 Sep 2026 (D-013). Limits are exclusive: maxPercent and maxAmount mean strictly under, minPercent and minAmount mean at or above.

rules.plainEnglish: A price change under 5 percent and under 2K can be made in SAP by the Ops Buyer.
A price change under 5 percent but of 2K or more needs Category Manager approval.
A price change of 5 percent or more needs Category Manager approval.
Any quantity change goes to the Planner.
Lead time, payment terms and other commercial terms belong to the Category Manager, not Ops.
